newsitem.title: HUNGARY: RICHTER, TVK HIT NEW HIGHS.
newsitem.headline: RICHTER, TVK HIT NEW HIGHS.

text.p: Stocks in Hungarian drugs firm Richter Gedeon continued to rise on Wednesday to a new record high, although the pace of its increase was slower than on Tuesday when its Q1 results triggered a rally.
The market's strongest gainer on Wednesday was chemicals firm TVK which has not yet released its January-March figures but from which the market expects very strong earnings, traders said.
Richter rose to a new record high of 14,250 forints and at 1016 GMT it traded at 13,800 forints, up 150 from Tuesday's close.
TVK broke the 3,000 forint level and rose to a new record level of 3,005 forints, before retreating. At 1020 GMT it traded at 2,930, up 125.

"Well informed investors bought Richter shares on Tuesday, while those who read its results only today, tried to buy today hoping that it will rise up to 15,000 forints," said Robert Cselovszki of WestLB Investment.

Richter's net profit in the first quarter of the year surged to 4.997 billion forints from 3.258 billion in the same three months of 1996, and its results triggered a huge rally in its price on Tuesday.
Also expectations of strong results drove the market's other chemicals stock Borsodchem strongly higher.
Borsodchem opened at 6,500 forints and surged to 6,650 forints. At 1018 GMT it traded lower, at 6,570 forints, up 70.
